_note: How each quest's steps nest, from the in-game quest log, because the sources list steps flat. `tree` lists the quest's steps in order: a string is a step id (o1 is the first listed step), a list is steps in order, {"all": [...]} is steps done in any order (boxed under the step before it), and {"any": [...]} completes when any one of its options is done. Every step must appear once. `optional` steps don't hold the quest back; steps whose text starts with "(Optional)" are marked so without being listed here. Ids stay the same, so saved progress keeps working.
